label: Order
caption: JOSE DURAN, INDIVIDUALLY AND AS REPRESENTATIVE OF A CLASS OF JUDGMENT CREDITORS OF THE ESTATE OF FERDINAND E. MARCOS V. UNITED STATES, ET AL.
text: UPON FURTHER CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant and the response filed thereto, IT IS ORDERED that the stay heretofore issued by the undersigned on November 5, 2025, is hereby vacated. Given the Government’s representation that it will not transfer the funds outside of the United States before the disposition of any petition for a writ of certiorari, the application for stay is denied.
